title: graphql-core 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows…
description: graphql-core versions 3.2.12 before 3.2.14 and 3.3.0rc1 before 3.3.2 contain a denial of service vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the parser's max_tokens limit by submitting GraphQL documents consisting of long runs of comments. The Lexer.lookahead function fully tokenizes these comments before enforcing limit checks, leading to excessive CPU and memory consumption proportional to the document size.
